player_prompt.intro:
Ami Player {player_id} Pig Dice khel eda.

Niyam:
- Apni palte, ami '[roll]' ba '[hold]' korte pari
- 2-6 roll korle: Apni palte total-te joda
- 1 roll korle: Apni palte total haraon aar palte ses
- Hold korle: Apni palte total apni score-te joda aar palte ses
- Sab theke age {winning_score} point pele jite

Jokhon apni palte, apni current score aar palte total dekhte parben.
'[roll]' korte die roll korben ba '[hold]' korte apni point bank korben.
